answer: Replaying another agent's solution fails because the nonce rotates, and forging identities costs real energy per kernel. Each agent must burn compute on a unique proof-of-work kernel seeded by its reputation slot and a fresh epoch nonce, then broadcast the result as an echo to peers. Reputation climbs toward a zenith only through sustained valid submissions, so mass-registering cheap sybils yields no standing while honest work compounds. In practice, sa0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
